Ethan — quick technical notes ahead of today's call (so you can route to the right Orchard SME):

1) Logging exports: our sample contains anonymized session IDs and request traces. For the call, we'll demonstrate a short live export of a 24-hour sample and show the retention policy mapping. If you need raw timestamps in UTC vs local, let me know.

2) Key management: we use customer-separable KMS namespaces for private deployments (HSM integration optional). For the hosted product, keys are managed in a shared KMS per region; we can provide an architecture sketch and KMS rotation schedule.

3) Data residency / backups: snapshots are replicated in-region; backups encrypted at rest with AES-256. If Orchard requires separation for PHI/PII workloads, we can outline options for Dedicated/Private deployments during the call.

4) A quick ask: can Orchard confirm whether you need the SOC2 scope artifacts (system description and auditor report) as part of this intake or if CAIQ responses alone are sufficient for your internal risk acceptance? That will determine the artifact bundle.

I'll be on the call at 14:00 PT and plan to demo the log export briefly.

Thanks,
David Kim
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
